dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the battles that happened previously...

dialogues.speaker: Ixcatl
dialogues.text: The Collective of Plenty wasn't the main focus of the Abyss's attacks this time and we made it through the battle relatively unscathed.

dialogues.speaker: Ixcatl
dialogues.text: Nevertheless... Some of our warriors were still embraced by the peace of eternal night.

dialogues.speaker: Ixcatl
dialogues.text: They defended their glory with strength and safeguarded the freedom of others. That is the greatest ending for any warrior.
